you is just as important.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

order

confidence!

text_block_list.text:

That lets me
run without any worries.

proud of,
but there are also things I'm
not so sure about.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:

think that'll
give us a better connection.

places I'd
like to go!

the
